column1: # Gene deletions that expand rDNA arrays in S. pombe: imaging screen of the Bioneer haploid deletion collection with the rDNA marker GapR-GFP; strains with high rDNA volume and high mean GFP intensity (above the wild-type threshold) in both the initial screen and the validation screen

# Cockrell AJ, Lange JJ, Wood C, Mattingly M, McCroskey SM, Bradford WD, Conkright-Fincham J, Weems L, Guo MS, Gerton JL. 2024. Regulators of rDNA array morphology in fission yeast. PLoS Genet 20:e1011331. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.1011331

# Source: pgen.1011331.s019.csv (S3 Table, rDNA quantification ratios and hits from the validation rDNA imaging screen) (https://journals.plos.org/plosgenetics/article/file?id=10.1371/journal.pgen.1011331.s019&type=supplementary)

# Cutoff: the paper's hit calls: rdna_volume and GFP_intensity both "high" in the initial screen (123 "high" hits, all retested) and again in the validation screen; 50 deletions pass (of 66 validation-screen strains with both calls high, which include ribosomal-protein deletions added only at validation); sorted by median rDNA volume in the validation screen
